UNIT 1

Bekantan (Proboscis Monkey)

Talk about an animal native to Indonesian wildlife.

Bekantan is a species of monkey which is native to the island of Borneo (Kalimantan). In English, it is called the proboscis monkey because of its unique long nose. Local people also call it monyet Belanda.

The bekantan has reddish-brown fur, a long tail, and a big belly. The male has a very long nose, while the female's nose is smaller and pointed. An adult male can weigh up to 24 kilograms, twice as heavy as the female. Its long nose is used to attract females and to make a loud sound.

Bekantans live in mangrove forests, swamps, and along the rivers of Kalimantan. They eat young leaves, seeds, and unripe fruits. They are excellent swimmers and can swim across rivers to look for food. Sadly, the bekantan is an endangered animal because its habitat is destroyed by deforestation.

📝 Vocabulary (klik untuk mendengar)

🔤 Grammar Focus: Adjectives

Adjective adalah kata sifat untuk menggambarkan ciri-ciri hewan. Letaknya sebelum kata benda atau setelah to be.
Before noun: The bekantan has a long nose. / It has reddish-brown fur.
After to be: The bekantan is rare and endangered.
SizeColourBody partCharacter
big, small, long, short, tallbrown, reddish, black, greyfur, tail, nose, belly, pawrare, endangered, wild, tame

UNIT 2

Orangutan and Gorilla

Identify specific information about Indonesian wildlife.

The orangutan is a great ape found in the rainforests of Sumatra and Borneo. Its name comes from the Malay words orang (person) and hutan (forest). Its fur is reddish-brown and its arms are very long — longer than its legs. An orangutan has strong hands to hang and swing from tree to tree. It spends most of its life in the trees and builds a nest to sleep in every night. Orangutans mostly eat fruits, especially durian and figs.

The gorilla lives in the forests of central Africa, not in Indonesia. Its fur is black and thick. A gorilla has a large head, a wide chest, and very strong arms. Unlike the orangutan, the gorilla walks on the ground using its knuckles. Gorillas live in groups led by a big male called a silverback. They eat leaves, stems, and fruits.

📝 Vocabulary

🔤 Grammar Focus: Possessive Adjectives & Has/Have

1. Possessive adjective menunjukkan kepemilikan, diikuti kata benda.
SubjectIYouHeSheItWeThey
Possessivemyyourhisheritsourtheir
Example: Its fur is reddish-brown. / Gorilla's fur is black. / Their arms are long.
⚠️ its (kepemilikan, tanpa apostrof) ≠ it's (= it is)
2. Has / Have untuk menyebutkan bagian tubuh yang dimiliki.
HASHe, She, It, an orangutan, a gorilla (tunggal)
HAVEI, You, We, They, orangutans, gorillas (jamak)
Example: An orangutan has long arms. / Gorillas have black fur.

UNIT 3

Indonesian Birds

Describe characteristics and features of an animal.

Cendrawasih, or the bird-of-paradise, is one of the most beautiful birds in the world. It is found in the forests of Papua, eastern Indonesia. It is often called the "bird of heaven" because of its amazing colourful feathers.

The male cendrawasih has bright yellow, red, and green feathers with two very long tail feathers. The female is smaller and its colour is duller. The beautiful feathers are used by the male to attract the female through a special dance on a tree branch.

Cendrawasih eats fruits, seeds, and small insects. Today the bird is protected by the Indonesian government because it is hunted for its feathers. Its forest home is also destroyed by illegal logging.

📝 Vocabulary

🔤 Grammar Focus: Passive Voice (Simple Present)

Kalimat pasif dipakai saat yang penting adalah objek/apa yang dikenai tindakan, bukan pelakunya.
RumusSubject + am/is/are + Verb 3 (+ by + pelaku)
Active: Galang brings binoculars to the forest.
Passive: Binoculars are brought by Galang to the forest.
Active: The government protects the cendrawasih.
Passive: The cendrawasih is protected by the government.
Verb 1Verb 3Verb 1Verb 3
findfoundhunthunted
callcalledprotectprotected
eateatendestroydestroyed
seeseenuseused
